name: Child's Pose Side Reach

instructions.description: Begin on hands and knees and move the hips back toward the heels.
Reach both hands forward, then walk them slightly to one side.
Breathe into the side of the rib cage.
Return through center and repeat to the other side.

performanceMetrics.notes: Record the time performed with comfortable, controlled technique.
Record a comfortable breathing rate without prescribing a universal norm.

variations.variationDescription: Child's Pose Side Reach — Supported Mobility Version: Add stable support or cushions to reduce balance or floor-access demands.

commentsNotes: Use cushions or a chair-supported version if floor kneeling is unsuitable.
